Sorting and hour-total logic
textPreview: Sorting and hour-total logic

text: Comparators change the record order, while aggregation calculates the hours.
textPreview: Comparators change the record order, while aggregation calculates the hours.

text:
INPUT sortMode

results = all experiences

IF sortMode is NEWEST
  SORT results by date descending
ELSE IF sortMode is OLDEST
  SORT results by date ascending
ELSE
  SORT results by category

totalHours = SUM each experience's hours
DISPLAY results and totalHours
